purpose: Four measured attention/error case illustrations; exploratory diagnostics, not population mechanism proof
archetype: quantitative grid with matched map panels
panels: two predictors in columns; semantic-colored geometry in upper row, common-scale attention in lower row; frozen GT and both best trajectories
source: paired actor attention CSV, frozen VAL graph geometry, frozen checkpoints, measured attention archives

case_rules.Case1: vehicle>5m; error delta>1m; relevant mass delta<-0.05, otherwise sign-consistent negative shift; largest error degradation first
case_rules.Case2: TurningVehicle_GT; opposite mass increased; error delta>1m; largest error degradation first
case_rules.Case3: TurningVehicle_GT; correct mass increased; error delta<-1m; largest improvement first
case_rules.Case4: vehicle>5m; error delta>1m; Stage7A relevant mass>=0.5; relevant mass not decreased; top1 attended lane GT distance<=2m; largest degradation first

selection: illustrative extreme within fixed criteria; distinct actor identities; not representative frequencies
review_risks: GT-defined future groups and relevance are strictly offline
attention is not a causal explanation
checkpoint weights differ between independently trained predictors
50m incoming mask can omit future-nearest lane
all figure data measured, no schematic fake trajectories
